doc: Fill in, save as edits.json, then: python3 course_data/mapper/write_layers.py colbert_hills. See course_data/mapper/BRIEF.md for ops, shapes and rules. long_grass: a verdict per side on every hole, 'native: <edits>' or 'none: <what both years show>' (S2 silence is not a verdict). s2_suggested: Sentinel-2 native candidates (hint, not a layer): per hole and side set every candidate's decision to accept (its shape becomes add native with your confidence + evidence; the 10-yd keep-out applies), reject (evidence = why) or replace (you drew your own native edit in `edits`, e.g. the traced edge); undecided ones are listed in review.md.

1.note: prairie with limestone outcrop line left beyond ~10 yds of mown rough; right is mown to cart path then house lots

long_grass.L: native: edit 0 (rock-outcrop line / mowing line ~10 yds off the fairway, same place 2023 and 2021)
long_grass.R: none: mown rough to the cart path at +27; beyond the path a narrow strip to the house lots, smooth green in 2021

edits.evidence: dark mown strip 8-11 yds wide then coarse tufted grass with a limestone outcrop line, same edge 2023 and 2021

L.evidence: coarse prairie with rock outcrops beyond the mown strip in both years; S2 edge comes in to 4 yds over mown rough; traced as edit 0 (and no native before along 200 near the practice green)
inside the prairie left at x -60..-70, covered by edit 0
prairie beyond rock line left at 290-390, both years; covered by edit 0 with measured 10-yd mown width

R.evidence: right of the cart path at 220-300: mixed mown grass running to house lots, smooth green in 2021, no second mowing line
330-345 right: cart path edge and mown rough between path and trees
on the cart path at 360-380, mown rough either side
